data.name: Ruthless Combatant
data.description: The phantom threatens a critical hit with its slam attacks on a roll of 19-20. When the spiritualist reaches 11th level, the phantom's critical modifier with slam attacks increases to x3. This doesn't stack with Improved Critical or similar effects.
